notes.title: First major update!
notes.content:
Thanks to suggestions from players with nicknames lebas and Mat ːsteamhappyː

A new document was added to the game. The player receives this document after each wrong decision. It indicates the text of the message and the reason that the player made the wrong decision.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31158934/e9ab9dc3aabde59e64c03c8272b60ca10d1dd701.png[/img]
